SHIPPED SEAM BUG (500-class): resolveSubject's find-or-create branch interpolates the curriculum-version code as `${code}-INGEST` where ${code} is a BIND PARAMETER — the SQL text becomes '$n-INGEST' which Postgres parses as (param n) minus (column INGEST) -> 'column "ingest" does not exist'. The vanilla POST /glm-ocr/pairs route therefore 500s for ANY paper whose subject code is not already seeded. Present at the r0 merge commit (7ab06ecb line ~289). r0 and r1 both avoid it via the seeded-subject find path. Filed here as a finding of record — the fix (inline the suffix into the parameter value) is a separate reviewed PR, never a silent lane patch
